The manual check LOCAL-1_TC_015 (the cart check seeded through the API) could not sign in. This project signs in through its own harness command, and the factory has no record of how to send that login as a request, so nothing was sent to the stand. Because of that, the case is missing from the run report and would read as untested. What would you like to do? You can set the login path and token field (or null if this capture needs no login) under manual_capture.login.http in config.json, then say retry. You can say go on, and the story carries your words with the case recorded as not run. You can say restart, and the runner starts again with your words, though it will hit the same refusal unless the config is fixed first. Or you can say stop.

## What each answer costs and does

(a) `retry` — You set manual_capture.login.http in config.json (path and token_field, or null), then the factory looks again.
the factory: Nothing now; the runner redoes the capture after your change.
you: A small config edit that only you can make.
the story: Nothing, once the capture runs and the case is recorded.; none, once the case has a lane; delivery waits until this is done

(b) `go on` — Go on without this case; your words are recorded as the reason.
the factory: Records a waiver for the missing lane.
you: None, apart from your words.
the story: LOCAL-1_TC_015 / OB-15 is never run.; The case is carried as not run, with your reason.; what it does to delivery is not known yet

(c) `restart` — Free the S6 runner dispatch so the driver starts it again, giving it your words.
the factory: Another runner round.
you: Your answer.
the story: LOCAL-1_TC_015 stays unverified unless the config is fixed first.; The env_blocked row, unless the config is fixed.; delivery waits until this is done

(d) `stop` — Stop the story here.
the factory: Nothing.
you: None.
the story: Everything not yet delivered.; -; the delivery verdict will read: not ready to ship as is.
